title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: In logistic regression, the probability of the binary outcome is modeled using the logistic function. This function maps any real-valued number into the $$(0,1)$$ interval.

title: Properties of the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, denoted as sigma, is defined as $$sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$. It always outputs a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$, exclusive of $$1$$.

title: Evaluating $$P(Y=1|X)$$
text: Since $$P(Y=1|X)=\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X^T \beta\right)$$, and sigma(z) is always less than $$1$$, $$P(Y=1|X)$$ is always less than $$1$$.
